diagnostics.message: google_project_iam_member.service_agents already depends on google_project_service.project_services transitively through google_project_service_identity.default; its direct depends_on on project_services duplicates that ordering.

google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_agent_cmek already waits for google_project_service.project_services through google_project_iam_member.service_agents, google_project_service_identity.default, and the service-account data sources.

google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_agent_cmek already depends on google_project_service_identity.default through google_project_iam_member.service_agents; the direct identity dependency is redundant.

google_project_iam_member.shared_vpc_host_robots already waits for google_project_service.project_services through its service-identity, default-service-account, and service-account data-source dependencies.

google_compute_subnetwork_iam_member.shared_vpc_host_robots already waits for google_project_service.project_services through its service-identity, default-service-account, and service-account data-source dependencies.

google_logging_project_sink.sink already depends on google_project_service.project_services through each of its three project IAM dependencies; the direct project_services dependency duplicates those paths.

google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service can attach the service project before google_project_service.project_services finishes enabling compute.googleapis.com. Unlike the host-side attachment resource, this resource has no API-enablement ordering. When this module enables Compute, wait for project_services before attaching the service project.

google_logging_metric.metrics calls the Logging API but does not wait for google_project_service.project_services. When logging.googleapis.com is enabled by this module, metric creation can race API activation; order metrics after project_services.

google_logging_project_exclusion.logging-exclusion has no ordering after google_project_service.project_services. When this module enables logging.googleapis.com, exclusion creation can call the Logging API before activation completes.

google_logging_log_scope.log-scopes uses the Logging API without waiting for google_project_service.project_services. When logging.googleapis.com is enabled here, log-scope creation can race that activation.

google_monitoring_notification_channel.channels uses the Monitoring API but has no dependency on google_project_service.project_services. When this module enables monitoring.googleapis.com, channel creation can run before activation finishes.

google_monitoring_alert_policy.alerts must wait for Monitoring API enablement by google_project_service.project_services. Its existing notification-channel dependency does not currently provide an API-enablement path, so alert creation can race monitoring.googleapis.com activation.

When alert conditions refer to log-based metrics created by this module, google_monitoring_alert_policy.alerts must follow google_logging_metric.metrics. Conditions and queries are passed through as opaque strings, so Terraform does not infer this ordering; policy creation can fail metric-existence validation while the metrics are still being created.
